name: Heart Fill
description: Small clickable heart with an animated wavy liquid inside. Each click pumps the heart and raises the liquid through several levels, then drains it and starts over.
contents: Heart-shaped clipped container with radial gradient
Animated three-layer liquid wave inside the heart
behavior: Click pumps the heart forward with a 3D perspective push
Liquid level rises on each click through preset levels and drains on the fourth
Waves slide horizontally in a continuous loop
Clicks are ignored while a pump animation runs
editableByProps: Heart size, gradient, liquid color and wave opacity
Pump depth and liquid levels per click

needsCodeEdit.where: path d attribute inside the clipPath element
hf-move keyframes and animation-duration rules in the style block
counterRef update at the end of pumpHeart

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Pump and liquid levels cycle through exactly four steps, so pumpLevels and tankLevels need four values
Tank color must be rgb or rgba format for the wave opacity layers
Fixed pixel size, small enough for 360px screens
